rule: Players turn cards over in turn, and whoever calls "snap" first when a card matches the one before it takes the whole pile. The trigger is not fixed -- it is always a comparison with the previous card, so nothing can be called while a single card is showing. Calling wrongly costs you a card from your stock, face up onto the pile.
eventSnapCorrect: {{name}} called snap and took the pile!
eventSnapWrong: {{name}} called wrongly and paid a card.
promptPlay: s ... turn a card / n ... call snap / t ... let the CPUs react
hintReasonDeclare: The top card matches the one before it
hintReasonStep: It is your turn to turn a card
hintReasonWait: No match yet -- calling wrongly costs a card
